strings.species-saugeye.e52c68cf: Sized for bank reality and small boats. Punderson Lake is electric only and small, so a kayak or a trolling motor covers it.
strings.species-saugeye.e6559083: Pymatuning has its own Ohio–Pennsylvania rules in the 2026–27 booklet. Walleye are 6 a day, 15″ minimum; saugeye fall under all other fish, with no limit.
strings.species-saugeye.e65ed298: Not a regular at Mosquito Creek Lake, so there are no where notes for this lake. See the Hoover notes on the Hoover view.
strings.species-saugeye.e6ce70fe: No public ramp (MWCD, USACE); 10 hp limit (MWCD).
strings.species-saugeye.ea14499d: Points near public ramps; lower lake structure by boat.
strings.species-saugeye.eb375377: Not a regular at West Branch Reservoir, so there are no where notes for this lake. See the Hoover notes on the Hoover view.
strings.species-saugeye.eed7d820: Boat (≤10 hp): slow troll or cast breaks; bank: long casts along drop.
strings.species-saugeye.f1cbe8a4: The marina and Lake Park ramps, the accessible pier and public shore (MWCD).
strings.species-saugeye.f527bb53: Sized for bank reality and small boats. East Branch Reservoir is electric only, so plan for a small trolling motor and battery.
strings.species-saugeye.f56050ff: Sized for bank reality and small boats. Mosquito Creek Lake has no horsepower limit, with no wake 300 ft from shore.
strings.species-saugeye.f89dcc7b: Not a regular at Delaware Lake, so there are no where notes for this lake. See the Hoover notes on the Hoover view.
strings.species-saugeye.f9262fb9: Sized for bank reality and small boats. Piedmont Lake has a 10 hp limit, so a small motor or a kayak does the job.
strings.species-saugeye.f9b7287e: Stocked by ODNR at Rocky Fork Lake every year: 261,205 fingerlings in 2025.
strings.species-saugeye.fafc00f1: Stocked by ODNR at Salt Fork Lake every year (458,583 fingerlings in 2025), and recorded in ODNR fish surveys.
strings.species-saugeye.fecc5ec0: None (the 15″ minimum applies only at Berlin, C.J. Brown, LaDue, Lake Milton, Mosquito Creek and West Branch)
